The '''Kathol system''' lay in [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

The Kathol system was centered on a binary pair of [[Star/Legends|stars]], and originally contained several [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including the world called [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the ancient [[Kathol (species)|Kathol]] race; it was also the location of the two massive [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[launch gate]]s which the Kathol used to colonize much of the surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sector]].

The Kathol system was home to the [[Battle of Kathol System]], which led to the defeat of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] and the liberation of Kathol by the [[New Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces.

By the time of the New Republic, the system contained the ravaged planet Kathol, [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the surviving launch gate, and two major [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|belts]], formed from the wreck of the other planets.

==Behind the scenes==
On page 25 of ''[[Endgame]]'', the twin stars of the Kathol system are identified as "binary yellow suns"; page 65, however, refers to "two suns&mdash;one a [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]], the other a yellow star."
